message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise‑complaint in Atlanta. The city’s noise ordinance is enforced by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** and the **City of Atlanta’s Office of the City Clerk**. Here’s how you can do it: | Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Call | |------|------------|---------------------------| | 1 | **Check the ordinance** – Atlanta’s noise ordinance (Title 10, Chapter 2 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) sets the limits for daytime, evening, and nighttime noise. Knowing the exact rule helps you describe the violation accurately. | | | 2 | **Gather evidence** – Record the time, location, and nature of the noise (audio clip, video, or written notes). If you have neighbors who also heard it, ask them to write down what they heard. | — | | 3 | **File online** – Use the City of Atlanta’s “Noise Complaint” portal. You’ll need to create an account or log in with your existing City of Atlanta login. | | | 4 | **Call the hotline** – If you prefer to speak to someone right away, call the Atlanta Police Department’s Noise Complaint Hotline at **(404) 656‑4000**. The dispatcher will take your details and send an officer to investigate. | (404) 656‑4000 | | 5 | **Submit a written complaint** – If you want a paper trail, mail or fax a written complaint to the City Clerk’s office. Include your contact information, the address of the offending property, and a description of the noise. | City Clerk, 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309
Fax: (404) 656‑4000 | | 6 | **Follow up** – After filing, you’ll receive a confirmation number. Keep it handy if you need to check on the status or provide additional information. | — | ### Quick Tips - **Time matters** – The ordinance distinguishes between daytime (7 a.m.–10 p.m.) and nighttime (10 p.m.–7 a.m.). Be sure to note the exact time the noise occurred. - **Neighborhood association** – If you’re part of a homeowners’ association or neighborhood group, they may already have a process for reporting noise. Check with them first; they might be able to handle it internally. - **Repeat offenders** – If the same property repeatedly violates the ordinance, the police can issue a citation or a summons. Persistent violations can lead to fines or even civil action. ### Contact Information | Agency | Phone | Email | Address | |--------|-------|-------|---------| | City of Atlanta Police Department – Noise Complaint Hotline | (404) 656‑4000 | — | — | | City of Atlanta Office of the City Clerk | (404) 656‑4000 | clerk@atlantaga.gov | 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309 | | City of Atlanta Online Portal | — | — | | Feel free to let me know if you’d like help drafting a written complaint or if you have any other questions about the process!
